messages:
pagerbot: [pagerduty] ALERT fired: service=inference-gateway | symptom=http_5xx_rate>12% (60s) | region=eu-west | unacked=45s

Alice: ack. night oncall here. grabbing dashboards and logs.

Bob: I see the spike in eu-west starting ~02:07 UTC. Mostly 502/504 from edge-proxy behind the LB. RPS steady.

Carla: infra alert board shows increased TCP resets on the LB -> backend connections around the same time. No deploys in the last 2 hours.

Alice: can someone paste the quick runbook? /runbook inference-5xx -> looks like routing fallback + scale edge-proxy + check backend health.

SupportBot: Notifying customers with open incidents in EU region: C-7731, C-8809. Sent initial note: "We're investigating increased 502s in EU, mitigation in progress."

Dave: Reporting from support: customers seeing intermittent failures on generation endpoints; retries sometimes succeed. Not seeing data corruption.

Alice: mitigation plan (short): 1) failover LB to eu-standby pool 2) scale edge-proxy-eu +3 replicas 3) enable model-fallback (low-priority routes) 4) monitor for 15m. executing 1 now.

Bob: confirm steps in runbook snippet:
```
1. Console -> Traffic -> Set region routing eu-west -> eu-standby
2. kubectl scale deploy/edge-proxy-eu --replicas=$(current+3)
3. If spike persists, disable canary and rollback latest image
4. If LB unstable, work with infra to rotate LB pool
```

Alice: rolled routing to eu-standby. Verified via request headers and prometheus labels. Error rate dropped from 21% -> 9% within 30s.

Carla: scaling edge-proxy-eu now. `kubectl scale` returned 0 -> replicas increasing. Watching pod readiness.

Bob: KV cache hit-rate dipped during the initial spike; warming is in progress. That should reduce load as warmed prefixes serve more requests.

SupportBot: Updated customers C-7731 and C-8809: "We've rerouted traffic to standby pool and are scaling proxies. Monitoring. ETA 30m."

Dave: customers replied: thanks for the quick response, they can tolerate updates. marking in ticket.

Alice: marking pager as mitigated for now. Leaving PD alert to auto-resolve after sustained drop. Creating incident: INC-2026-0416-5xx-euwest-keepalive

Emma: tagging product & comms for potential status page message if this resurfaces. Impact estimate?

Alice: impact summary: intermittent 502/504 in eu-west affecting ~0.6% of requests over a 10m window; small number of customers had visible failures. Cause suspected: LB->backend TCP keepalive resets increasing connection closures and causing proxy upstream errors. Mitigation: reroute and scale. Next: infra to gather LB connection metrics, TLS session churn, and healthcheck timing. Eng to consider circuit-breaker tuning and backoff.

Bob: adding timeline & logs to incident doc. Will chase LB team for deeper metrics. I'll pick this up in morning.

Carla: recording pod logs for edge-proxy-eu: `upstream closed connection while reading response` and TCP RSTs in kernel logs. Sharing artifacts in INC doc.

Alice: handing off to @Bob for morning follow-up at shift change (06:00 UTC). If errors reappear, re-open PD rotation.

pagerbot: [pagerduty] Alert auto-resolved: condition recovered. Incident state: mitigated.

Alice: closing thread but leaving postmortem action items in INC-2026-0416-5xx-euwest-keepalive. Please add any additional findings there.
